paragraphs.text: Record MCP once. Replay it safely inside DeepSeek Harness.
An unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin for deterministic MCP record/replay.
Capture a real tool session once, replay it without credentials or network, and inspect every match
and contract change inside DSH.

## Why DSH Echo?

MCP tools often sit in front of APIs, databases, and services that make agent
tests slow, costly, no

ndeterministic, or unsafe. DSH Echo puts a cassette
between DSH and the real MCP server: record once

against reality, then replay
the exact conversation offline.

| stdio and Streamable HTTP/SSE | deterministic request matching |
| append-only, versioned JSONL |

| secrets redacted before disk | no real server on a normal repl

| Session-scoped Web inspector | contract snapshots |
| arguments, results, hit/miss state | classif

ied schema drift |
| compact Trajectory annotations | breaking-change CI gate |
